body:
Round137 consolidates the accepted GI-TBC method into one maintained paper and run profile after the Round136 mainline integration. On this branch, the public paper-S2 entry now binds the actual frozen Round137 vectors; ENS-C compatibility and the historical R135 profile remain intact. Research controls isolate AM and the four declared mechanism contrasts.

The completed preregistered study contains 120 native positions on 16 base inputs, 20 physical and 24 objective configurations. Seed0 breadth certifies GI-TBC 9/12 versus P 7/12 and PS 7/12; positive-resource configurations give 4/8 versus 0/8 and 0/8. The paper retains paid-start reversals, opposed endpoints, every open n35 resource run, limited Seed differences and the reversal of all three K15 deletion-time directions at Seed1. The stage decision keeps AM .08, pair-only and AP off. This does not pool historical versions, infer additive component speedups or transfer certificates between methods.

The R135 manuscript lineage now includes a question-led body, complete model/algorithm appendices, full supplemental observations, references and a visually checked 46-page PDF. The source/raw carriers preserve all current outcomes and failures while excluding commercial native assets, credentials and foreign full texts. Three author/source metadata groups remain explicitly unconfirmed for discussion; no submission is requested.

Validation: actual 28-vector entry expansion plus six refusal cases (zero native execution); independent scientific and document/PDF review; all-page PDF visual acceptance; all120-position strict local pure replay PASS; the initial public semantic replay reached its finite time limit after anonymous transfer and per-member expansion checks completed; a same-root metadata-I/O resumption is RUNNING after independent review, and public PASS is not yet claimed. Native computation was 118955.400563s (33.043167h) of the 60h ceiling, with nested H/LP/MIP not counted twice. Public restore performs no Optimize, build or vendor-DLL load.

The failed public attempt is preserved in its sole owned root. Its actual result, bounded post-PR cleanup and final delivery audit will be committed before goal completion. This PR remains Draft and targets main.
